en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4754 - It was narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
A man stood before the Commander of the Faithful (as) and said: "I divorced my wife during her waiting period (ʿiddah) without any witnesses."
Imam (as) replied: "Your divorce is not valid. Return to your wife."
